summary_en: Toyo Drilube updated its capital cost and stock price-conscious management targets. The company reanalyzed current performance and revised progress toward its capital efficiency objectives first announced in September 2024.
title_en: Updates on Measures to Realize Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: On September 11, 2026, Toyo Drilube released an update to its capital cost and stock price-conscious management initiatives first announced on September 13, 2024. The company has reanalyzed current conditions and revised its progress report on these strategic measures. The specific updated targets, performance metrics, or revised timelines are contained in the attached materials referenced in the disclosure. This update represents the company's continued focus on improving capital efficiency and aligning management decisions with shareholder value creation through cost-of-capital awareness.
